Name: DeserokUtils
Author: deserokk
Description:
Small quality-of-life utilities, one feature per tab.

CastWatch: gate a macro line on whether an action actually went off -- including instant casts and oGCDs, which have no cast bar to observe. It never sends anything on your behalf; it only runs or suppresses a line you already wrote.

FateWatch: warn before a cyclic FATE spawns, predicted from the last spawn it actually saw. Says 'not seen yet' rather than inventing a number.

FcBuffs: keep the Free Company buffs running, refreshed from the FC's existing stock in cities and residential districts. Spends no credits -- activating an action the FC already bought is free.

DrawSheathe: one key that draws or sheathes, whichever is currently correct. The Gold Saucer draw and sheathe animations are separate emotes rather than replacements for the default weapon toggle, so they cannot be bound as a toggle and take two hotbar slots. /drawsheathe reads whether your weapon is out and plays the right one. The emote is silently refused while you are moving or jumping -- or if you do not own it, since the draw and sheathe emotes are bought separately -- so all of those fall back to the game's own draw/sheathe and a single key covers every case. Both emote commands are configurable, and a held key collapses to one toggle.

EmoteQuiet: announce an emote the first time, then stay quiet about repeats of that same emote for a minute. Clapping through a whole performance says you clapped once instead of fifty times. Optionally hides other people's repeats from your own log too, kept per sender.

Mouseover: /ifmo picks the first target the action would actually land on. Write {mo}, or chain candidates like {mo|2}, ending with |noop to send nothing at all when none of them would land -- one line instead of a twelve-line mouseover macro with a fallback at the bottom.

Interact: /dsuinteract operates the thing in front of you and nothing else. Confirm drives world objects AND menus, so with your bags open those presses land in the menu and activate whatever is under the cursor. A dedicated key cannot do that, and it never changes your target either.

AchievementData: asks the game for your completed achievements once per login. Clicking an achievement link in chat opens your Achievements at "Last Five" instead of the achievement itself, because the client has not loaded the data yet and cannot navigate to a page it does not have. One request fixes it for every link, and nothing is stored.

EphemeralMarks: a marker over the heads of the people you queued in with, so you can find them in a Frontline or an alliance raid. Client-side only -- nobody else sees it, and it leaves the shared party marks alone. The party is read once when the queue pops and frozen there, so it survives the game reshuffling your premade into an alliance. A star for the party leader and a reticle for everyone else, or any icon you like, and a specific friend can be given their own shape and colour. Off outside PvP, field operations, alliance raids and deep dungeons, and off automatically when you queued as the whole group.
